newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian lending rate down 10 bps to 11.7 pct.
newsitem.headline: Croatian lending rate down 10 bps to 11.7 pct.

text.p: The Croatian average lending rate fell 10 basis points to 11.7 percent on Monday in slow trade marked by weak demand for kuna funds, dealers said.
They put daily settlements at a modest 17.9 million kuna, of which only 5.1 million were fresh borrowings.
The end of trading left a surplus of 22.1 million kuna on the supply side.
Insurers rolled over a previous 7.8 million kuna loans at steady nine percent and banks extended old term loans at rates varying from 12 to 17 percent.
The central bank calculated its kuna midrates for Tuesday slightly firmer at 6.0390 against the dollar and 3.5740 against the German mark. -- Zoran Radosavljevic, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
